items.title: ECG-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Targeted Electrocardiogram Waveform Evolution
items.reason_zh: 限定纳入 construction-repair 生成器自身的算子、提示和可复用技能版本。正文分别记录配方改变数据混合、operator/prompt repair 改变构造策略；失败反馈触发真实组件修订，旧新版本按相同源信号、请求、随机种子和预算回归比较，通过后将版本与适用范围保留到下一轮。学习器另行 SFT，符合 owner 的权重与 Harness 共演化规则。旧 unknown 来自对象边界分歧，保留原意见及本次纠正，不把生成训练样本本身作为纳入理由。
items.modified_object: Data-construction operator/prompt/skill implementations and separately trained learner weights
items.feedback: Construction failures and independent operator/question regression checks
items.retention: Version and next-round scope retained; accepted learner and recipe/policy versions promoted

quotes.quote: Repairs follow failures [ 46 ] : signal errors guide operator revisions; missing morphology guides applicability/retrieval revisions; ambiguity guides question/context revisions; unsupported explanations guide prompt revisions.

Repairs record their trigger, changed rule, validation result, and scope. Old and revised versions are compared on matched sources, requests, seeds, and budgets ; adoption requires signal and question checks to pass. Appendices A.2 and A.3 describe the rules and recording protocol; Appendix D provides stage prompts.

Recipes also fix source/edit constraints, replay, and training budgets. Recipe selection changes the data mixture; operator or prompt repair changes ϕ t \phi_{t} . These interventions are tracked separately (Appendix A.1 ).

Each skill specifies applicability, sources, operator order, parameter ranges, failure handling, and question rules. Updates record feedback, changes, proposer, both versions, validation results, and next-round scope. Compare the original and revised versions on the same source signals, requests, random seeds, and attempt budgets, and adopt revisions after independent operator and question regression checks .

1. Score the accepted learner on V fb V_{\mathrm{fb}} and probe training candidates to update category, difficulty, and error profiles. 2. Propose a bounded recipe set 𝒜 t \mathcal{A}_{t} from these profiles and prior outcomes; save the proposer and exact recipe. 3. Construct and validate each recipe’s training data under fixed gates. From the same parent checkpoint , run matched small-budget SFT branches with fixed replay and optimizer settings. 4. Compare candidates under the registered selection protocol, including forgetting and output validity. 5. Promote the accepted candidate and its recipe/policy versions, then remeasure for the next round . Full-budget retraining of a pilot winner restarts from the registered parent and requires validation before promotion. For branch a a , the simplest candidate utility is Δ ​ U t ​ ( a ) = S sel ​ ( SFT ⁡ ( θ t , D t a ∪ R t , b ) ) − S sel ​ ( θ t ) , \Delta U_{t}(a)=S_{\mathrm{sel}}\!\left(\operatorname{SFT}(\theta_{t},D_{t}^{a}\cup R_{t};b)\right)-S_{\mathrm{sel}}(\theta_{t}), (6) Here Δ ​ U t ​ ( a ) \Delta U_{t}(a) is the selection-score improvement of branch a a over its parent, not a weighted sum over branches. S sel S_{\mathrm{sel}} evaluates a learner on V sel V_{\mathrm{sel}} and is distinct from the external seven-benchmark score S7. Here b b is the shared pilot budget; S sel S_{\mathrm{sel}} is the preregistered capability-macro score over fixed eligible tasks.

Prompt P5 System role. You propose a minimal repair to a failed data-construction component while keeping the acceptance criteria fixed . User inputs. [failed attempt and evidence], [failure codes], [current operator/prompt/skill version], [allowed repair scope], [fixed regression suite], [attempt budget]. Instructions. Map numerical or boundary failures to operator repair; missing morphology to applicability or donor retrieval; ambiguity/leakage to question or context repair; unsupported explanation to response-prompt repair. Specify the exact change and why it addresses the observed failure. Compare old and new versions on the same sources, requests, seeds, and budget. Quarantine or reject when the budget is exhausted . Output fields. Triggering failure; component; exact revision; old/new version; proposer; validation results; acceptance rationale; next-round scope.

items.agreement: Primary and independently frozen reviewer recommend limited harness/coevolution. Key repair, validation and retention passages are present in both current v1 and candidate v2.
